title: Taiwanese American Students Association of Northwestern University
content_html:
The Taiwanese American Students Association (TASA) at Northwestern University is a student organization dedicated to celebrating Taiwanese and Taiwanese American culture on campus. Founded in 1992 under the name Taiwanese American Students Club (TASC), it was formally recognized by the Associated Student Government in January 1994. The organization has since grown from an original group of eight members into an ASG A-status organization welcoming students of all backgrounds.

TASA was established to provide a forum in which Taiwanese history, culture, and current events could be openly shared and celebrated within the broader Northwestern community. Its programming includes an annual Taiwanese Night Market, Lunar New Year celebrations, game nights, speaker events, and cultural outings to Chicago neighborhoods. The organization is affiliated with the intercollegiate Taiwanese American network and has held the ITASA Midwest conference within its regional community.

The organization maintains an active presence through its Instagram (@northwesterntasa), Facebook page, and Linktree, and is listed in Northwestern’s official club directory, Wildcat Connection. It is also featured on Northwestern University’s own website in connection with student engagement programming.
